title: refactor(app-shell): retire the post-build transition's dead halves — Studio's run-landing reader, the full-page opt-out flag, the stale ADR citation (objectui#12842)
body:
Fixes #12842
Clause-②: no

## What

objectui#12724 (PR #12841) removed the automatic navigation into Studio after an AI build. This retires the three things it left with no other half, all at once, and every remaining citation of a section ADR-0080 does not have:

1. **Studio's run-mode landing reader.** `studioLanding.ts` (`STUDIO_RUN_LANDING`, `isStudioRunLanding`) is deleted. `StudioDesignSurface`'s `landedInRun` reader goes, along with the one-shot `landingCollapsedRef` it drove and the now-unused `useLocation` import. The properties-collapse state and `canvasMode` now start at `false` and `'design'` with plain setters.
2. **The full-page opt-out flag.** `ConsoleLayout.openDockFullPage` and `StudioAiCopilot.openFullPage` no longer write `sessionStorage['objectstack:ai-full-page-requested']`. Its only reader was the retired transition.
3. **The "ADR-0080 D5" citations.** objectstack's ADR-0080 has no D-numbered sections. The citation goes back to PR #2623, whose title named it.
   - `ChatbotEnhanced`'s `onDesignBuiltApp` doc comment now describes what the card draws: "Open app" (打开应用) is the primary action and "Design in Studio" (在 Studio 中查看) the secondary one. Studio is primary only when the host passes no `onOpenBuiltApp` (objectui#12724).
   - `artifactStudioPath.ts` and its test header now state the rule itself: every AI-built artifact links to the Studio pillar where it can be edited by hand, with no AI needed. They cite objectui#2623, which introduced it.
   - The `ChatbotEnhanced.test.tsx` comment now says the pin it replaced came from objectui#2623.

   No ADR holds that rule, so none is cited. These are comment changes only.

## Behaviour after the change

- **Arrival in the Interfaces pillar:** every arrival opens on 「设计」 with the properties aside open. That is what an arrival without the landing state already did, and since #12841 no arrival carried it.
- **Console dock full-page button:** it records where it was pressed, then opens `/ai` (no bound package) or `/ai/build?package=PKG`. Only the storage write is gone.
- **Studio copilot full-page button:** it records where it was pressed, then opens `/ai/build?package=PKG`. Only the storage write is gone.

## Retired pins (Acceptance 2)

| Retired | What it pinned |
|---|---|
| `StudioDesignSurface.runLanding-11658.test.tsx` (whole file) | The reader of `STUDIO_RUN_LANDING` in the Interfaces pillar. Its producer, the post-build navigation in `AiChatPage`, was removed by #12841. |
| `ConsoleLayout.dockBinding-10926.test.tsx`: the `OPT_OUT` const, `getItem(OPT_OUT)` toBe `'1'` (bound thread) and `getItem(OPT_OUT)` toBeNull (app-less thread) | The dock's write of `objectstack:ai-full-page-requested`. Its reader was the retired transition. The navigation and return-location asserts in the same tests stay. |

## Pins that keep the unchanged behaviour covered

- `StudioDesignSurface.canvasMode.test.tsx`, new case "an arrival opens on Design with the properties aside open". This was the control case of the retired file.
- New `__tests__/studioCopilotOpenFullPage-12842.test.tsx`: the copilot's full-page button goes to `/ai/build?package=app.crm` and records the Studio URL it left. Nothing pinned this button before.

Both pins pass on `main`'s source before the removal (2 files, 4 tests) and on this head. They pin behaviour that does not change, so there is no ablation.

## Evidence

- Acceptance 1: `git grep -n "STUDIO_RUN_LANDING\|isStudioRunLanding\|ai-full-page-requested" HEAD -- packages apps` prints nothing (exit 1). Control: the same grep on `044f231` exits 0 with 13 lines.
- Acceptance 3: `git grep -n "ADR-0080 D[0-9]" -- packages apps examples ':!**/CHANGELOG.md'` on ed0eeefe3 prints nothing (exit 1). Control: the same grep on f3cd6ad prints 3 lines (`artifactStudioPath.ts:5`, `artifactStudioPath.test.ts:7`, `ChatbotEnhanced.test.tsx:1039`).
- Full suite, `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell test` at f3cd6ad, before the main merge: Test Files 1553 passed, 1 skipped (1554); Tests 14621 passed, 9 skipped. Exit 0.
- Targeted families at f3cd6ad (114 files naming StudioDesignSurface, ConsoleLayout, StudioAiCopilot, ChatbotEnhanced, dockBinding or studioCopilot): 114 passed, 838 tests.
- At ed0eeefe3, after merging origin/main 97538115b:
  - `app-shell^...` build: exit 0.
  - app-shell and plugin-chatbot `type-check`: exit 0.
  - vitest on `artifactStudioPath.test.ts` and `ChatbotEnhanced.test.tsx`: 2 files, 98 tests passed.
  - `check:changeset-claims`, `changeset:check`, `check-changeset-presence`, `check:new-line-citations`: all exit 0.
- eslint on the changed files at f3cd6ad: 0 errors, warning counts unchanged from main.
- Live reading: NOT MEASURED, reason: no user reach.

## Changesets

- `.changeset/12842-retire-built-transition.md` (`@object-ui/app-shell`, patch)
- `.changeset/12842-chatbot-studio-door-comment.md` (`@object-ui/plugin-chatbot`, patch, comment only)

The presence gate counts a comment change under `src/` as published source, so plugin-chatbot gets its own changeset.

## Acceptance notes

- `AiChatPage.noNavigationAfterBuild-12724.test.tsx` still asserts that the Studio door navigates with no router state. That still holds and is left as is (seat ruling A).
- Recorded deviation: an unpushed local commit carried a model-named trailer. It was undone with a soft reset of that commit only and re-made with the model-free pair. No pushed history changed (seat ruling A).
